verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents review tools for manual fraud review (docs-17). It gives access to collected document images and extracted data (docs-4, docs-16), and reviewer decisions write back to the record through status override (docs-10) and document blocklisting (docs-11). However, nothing shows borderline or low-confidence verifications being automatically routed into a dedicated review queue with check results bundled for reviewers. missing for 10: automatic routing of borderline cases into a review queue, a documented reviewer view combining images, extracted fields and per-check results, independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
